title: COVID-19 Impact on Construction Costs and Estate Upgrading and Greening Plans
what_it_is: COVID-19 Impact on Construction Costs and Estate Upgrading and Greening Plans

sections.label: Construction cost increase factors
sections.summary: Construction costs rose from foreign manpower costs, Safe Management Measures and material costs, with a $1.36 billion support package sharing firms' costs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: The contributing factors include an increase in foreign manpower costs due to border measures that limit the inflow of our migrant workers, additional costs and reduced productivity due to the Safe Management Measures at the worksite to lower the risk of transmission in the sector, as well as increases in the cost of construction materials.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: For example, the $1.36 billion Construction Support Package helps share the costs that firms have incurred for implementing safe management measures, as well as non-manpower related prolongation costs for public sector construction projects.

sections.label: Public sector tender prices
sections.summary: Measures mitigated some cost increases, but public sector construction tender prices generally rose this year versus pre-COVID-19 levels.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: These measures have mitigated some of the cost increases facing construction firms.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: That said, tender prices for public sector construction projects, including public housing and upgrading projects, have generally increased this year compared to pre-COVID-19 levels.

sections.label: Cost increase not passed down
sections.summary: The increase in cost will not be passed down to flat buyers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: The increase in cost will not be passed down to flat buyers.

sections.label: NRP tender schedule
sections.summary: NRP tenders are usually scheduled from the second half of 2021 onwards, with work to commence in 2022.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: On the first question on the various upgrading programmes, for example, the NRP which the Member has referenced, these tenders are usually scheduled to be called from the second half of 2021 onwards and work should commence in 2022.

sections.label: Green building targets 2030
sections.summary: Targets are 80% of buildings green by 2030, 80% of new developments Super Low Energy, and 80% energy efficiency improvement for best-in-class buildings.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: Eighty percent of buildings to be green by 2030, 80% of new developments to be Super Low Energy buildings and achieving 80% improvement in energy efficiency for best-in-class buildings by 2030.

sections.label: Singapore Green Plan progress
sections.summary: The overall progress of the Singapore Green Plan is on track.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: The overall progress of the Singapore Green Plan is on track.

sections.label: Construction cost and 2030 targets
sections.summary: This is a small part of the construction cost, and the commitment is to achieve those targets by 2030.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: Overall, this is a small part of the construction cost and we are committed to achieving those targets by 2030.
